name: 78537 · Donna, TX
findings: ZIP 78537 (Donna) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (83% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78537 (Donna) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
